title: The micro-action library, merged across both banks
description: Every rung one and rung two action, with the worked-if each is confirmed against. The team bank ships no actions of its own today: it maps into these same issue files, so this file is the whole library for both tracks.

pillar.description: The export spells the CLOVER dimension "Opportunities"; the loader canonicalises it to "Opportunity" and passes everything else through, because element is an open value.

worked_if.description: What the manager confirms. A rung one route with no worked-if halts the loader. Read through the delivered-worked-if accessor, because a prerequisite substitution replaces it (spec 5.1.4).

route.description: Which rung one route this action is authored for, or null for a structural or gesture action that is not a rung one at all.
